sentences.en: Every butterfly has been a larva, but not all larvae will become butterflies.
sentences.zh: 每只蝴蝶都曾是幼虫，但并非所有的幼虫都会变成蝴蝶。

sentences.en: The life cycle of an amphibian consists of three stages: egg, larva and adult.
sentences.zh: 两栖动物的生活周期包括三个阶段：卵、幼体和成年期。

sentences.en: While still inside its beeswax cell, the larva is fed by nurse worker bees.
sentences.zh: 在蜜蜂蜡制的巢室内，幼虫由工蜂照顾并喂养。
